KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
